name: The Satyr
description: A stout, playful, unnamed satyr who teaches Zosimos that worry is Phenax's creation and that a hero leaves behind goodness, and who gives him a rusty knife.

timeline.summary: A satyr springs onto the path, tells Zosimos his mind's garden is full of weeds, and says worry is Phenax's creation that spurns Iroas.
timeline.quote: When you worry, you're actually worshipping Phenax.

timeline.summary: The satyr tells of the Underworld's coinsmiths who mint ostraka from funerary masks, and explains that Erebos equalizes everyone and forbids a return except as one of the Returned.
timeline.quote: Erebos cares little for what you were in life. He only cares that you once existed.

timeline.summary: The satyr teaches that a true hero is concerned with what he leaves behind, the flowering of goodness, rather than titles or a death mask.
timeline.quote: A hero is not concerned with a death mask or a fancy title or property, a hero is concerned with the flowering of goodness in all its forms.

timeline.summary: The satyr gives Zosimos a taste of nectarvine sap and tells him the world is good, and that a hero brings awareness of it and defends people from harm.
timeline.quote: The world is good, my boy.

timeline.summary: The satyr gives Zosimos a dull, rusty knife and warns that darkness will try to snuff out an awakened hero's light, then skips off into the woods.
timeline.quote: When a hero is awakened, all manner of things come from the darkness to snuff out the hero's light.

timeline.summary: The satyr's dagger bursts into heat and light, becoming a shining sword forged by the gods.
timeline.quote: the satyr's dagger had become a shining sword forged by the gods.

relations.note: The satyr gives Zosimos lessons on heroism.
relations.quote: It looks like you need some lessons.
